ios.desc:
Arbory puts your Plausible Analytics dashboard on your iPhone, with native widgets, push notifications, and offline access. Connect to Plausible Cloud or your self-hosted instance and check your traffic in seconds -- no browser required.

GLANCEABLE STATS ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
Add small, medium, large, or lock screen widgets that show your visitor count, pageviews, and trends at a glance. Your analytics live right on your home screen, updating throughout the day.

A COMPLETE NATIVE DASHBOARD
All 9 Plausible dashboard sections, rebuilt for iPhone:
- Real-time visitor count with live updates
- Visitor and pageview trends with interactive Swift Charts
- Top pages, sources, countries, and more
- Touch any chart point for exact values with haptic feedback
- Pull to refresh, or let background sync keep things current

TRAFFIC ALERTS AND DAILY SUMMARIES
Get notified when traffic spikes or drops unexpectedly. Receive a daily digest of your key metrics at the time you choose. Notifications are processed entirely on your device -- no intermediary servers.

WORKS WITH CLOUD AND SELF-HOSTED
Connect to Plausible Cloud with your API key, or point Arbory at your self-hosted Plausible instance. Custom URLs, reverse proxy setups, and non-standard ports all supported. Your data flows directly from your phone to your Plausible server.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
Arbory is built on the same principles as Plausible itself:
- Zero third-party SDKs or tracking libraries
- No analytics, no crash reporters, no ads
- Your API key is stored in iOS Keychain
- Direct connection only -- no data passes through our servers
- "Data Not Collected" on the App Store privacy label

BUILT FOR THE WAY YOU WORK
- Manage multiple sites with quick switching
- Offline access with cached data from your last session
- Face ID and Touch ID protection for your analytics
- Dark mode that follows your system setting
- Available in 7 languages: English, German, French, Dutch, Spanish, Portuguese, and Japanese

FREE TO TRY, ONE-TIME PURCHASE TO UNLOCK
Download free and explore your dashboard with full functionality for one site. Upgrade to Arbory Pro for €14.99 (one-time, not a subscription) to unlock:
- All home screen and lock screen widgets
- Extended date ranges (30 days, 6 months, 12 months, custom)
- Unlimited sites and quick switching
- Goal and conversion tracking
- Traffic Alert and Daily Summary notifications
- Interactive chart features

No subscription. Pay once. Yours forever.

Arbory requires a Plausibl

show_hn.title: Show HN: Arbory – Native iOS dashboard and widgets for Plausible Analytics

quotes.text:
Hey HN.

Long-time lurker (2017) here, but finally something to post about.

I've been building an iOS companion app for Plausible over the past few months. There are some great ones out there already, but I have always wanted to try building an app first-hand. I'm quite proud of the end result, so I wanted to share it online to see if people would be interested in using it.

In case you don't know: Plausible Analytics (https://plausible.io/) is a privacy-friendly alternative to Google Analytics. You can self-host it or choose to use their SaaS platform.

I chose Plausible Analytics because of their business philosophy: Privacy should come first. Arbory is built to connect directly to Plausible (either SaaS or self-hosted).

Features include:

- iOS Liquid Glass-native dashboard displaying most of your website analytics.

- Tap to filter data, just like Plausible itself.

- Notifications for traffic spikes and drops, the algorithm lives fully on your phone. (I'm quite proud of this one in particular)

- Full suite of widgets for your lock & home screen.

There are no subscriptions involved. You'll get the full dashboard and filtering for one site for free. There's a one-time unlock for $14.99 for the rest, if desired.

I'll lurk around here to answer any questions you might have. Any feedback is appreciated.

More information:

- Website: https://arbory.io

- Privacy Policy: https://arbory.io/privacy

- App Store Link: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760103214
